Voyager 1 has just reached a major milestone: one light-day from Earth. item.title: 1000s of Our Galaxy's Pulsars Are Missing. Scientists Just Figured Out Why.
item.author: Astrum
item.content:encoded:
We detected a mysterious disappearing signal in the heart of our galaxy. Try Brilliant’s interactive tutor for free and get 20% off an annual Premium subscription at http://brilliant.org/astrum
▀▀▀▀▀▀
Alien-hunting telescope “Breakthrough Listen” detected a faint pulsing signal… but then it disappeared. Now they’re searching the centre of our galaxy for the source. Is this one of the thousands of missing pulsars scientists predicted should exist, but can’t seem to find? And could this discovery finally prove general relativity?
